Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. As discussed, attaching our bank letter to prove account ownership and the routing details for ACH and wire. We plan to receive the first remittance under Redwood P.O. 54872 next week (net 30). Quick notes below so your payops team can map invoices correctly: 

- Company name on invoices: HarborLine Logistics Inc.
- Preferred remittance reference: INV-{invoice_number} / PO-54872
- Accounting contact: finance@harborline.io (cc'd)

Files attached: harborline_bank_letter.pdf (bank letter), HarborLine_W-9_signed.pdf (signed W-9).

Please confirm whether you need micro-deposit verification from our side or if Redwood runs micro-deposits to validate. Also, confirm the invoice label that will appear on your remittance report so our AP team can reconcile.

Appreciate it —
Liam

Hi Liam —

Thanks for sending the bank letter and W-9. A couple quick asks so we can finish vendor activation in the payops portal and tie your account to PO 54872: 

1) Can you confirm the EIN exactly as printed on the W-9? I want to avoid a mismatch during ACH validation.
2) Which remittance field do you prefer as the primary reconciliation key: INV-{invoice_number} or VendorRef-{vendor_id}? We can add both but want to make sure the PO label matches the first remittance.
3) We typically run two micro-deposits for ACH verification (under $0.10 each). Please confirm whether HarborLine prefers to accept those small debits or provide an alternative bank confirmation method.

Operational notes for our side: Marissa will create the vendor record and PrIyom will set the PO mapping and remittance label in the payment pipeline. Once micro-deposits clear, we schedule the first payment cycle on the next available run (target: 2028-08-18).

If you prefer a short 15-min call to confirm, I can schedule one this afternoon.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
[signature]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harborline.io>

Karthik —

Thanks. EIN on the W-9 is 12-3456789 (matches the attached). For reconciliation please use INV-{invoice_number} as the primary field; VendorRef is available as a secondary tag. HarborLine is fine with micro-deposits — please go ahead to initiate them.

One more thing: our finance team requires that the remittance report includes the PO number in the first three characters of the reference field so our ERP picks it up automatically. Can you set the remittance label to PO-54872|INV-{invoice_number}?

Happy to hop on a quick call if anything else is needed.

Best,
Liam
